# Acorn

`acorn.cjs` is the unmodified `dist/acorn.js` from Acorn 8.15.0 (MIT).
`acorn.LICENSE` contains its license. Used to parse JavaScript for selective loading;
no npm installation is needed at runtime.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/acorn/-/acorn-8.15.0.tgz
